text:
Lina: Quick sync — post-launch for Starter Templates webinar. We pushed the blog + launch posts at 09:00. Need to run credit experiment + 3 nudges in onboarding. Goal: move DAU->activated from 12% -> 18% in the next 2 weeks. Thoughts?

Tom: Saw the posts, looks good. Can we A/B subject lines for follow-up emails? cc @Rebecca

Omari: Metrics snapshot: last 24h traffic 4.2k, signups 320, activation (first-5-requests) 11.8%. Cohort source breakdown: webinar 47%, organic 33%, referrals 20%. Will attach chart in follow-up.

Rebecca: Proposed experiment plan:
- Variant A: 50 credits on sign-up + "starter prompts" modal
- Variant B: 0 credits + highlighted prompt templates in onboarding
- Variant C: 20 credits + contextual nudges after first failed generation
Also want to test timing of nudge: immediate vs 24h.
Can we route webinar signups to dedicated onboarding flow? @Tom for copy + @Omari for cohorts

Lina: Yes route. We'll use webhook tag `webinar_2026` to route to onboarding flow. Need eng support to add rule in routing table.

Airflow Bot: Job created: onboarding-route-update -> runs Tue 02:00 UTC. DAG: onboarding_routes_v3 :white_check_mark:

Omari: Quick config for experiment (pseudo):
```
experiment: starter_templates_credits
variants:
 - name: credits_50; credit_amount:50; onboarding_modal:true
 - name: no_credits_templates; credit_amount:0; show_templates:true
 - name: credits_20_nudge24h; credit_amount:20; nudge_delay_hours:24
target_metric: pct_activated_first_5_requests
duration_days:14
traffic_allocation: equal
```

Tom: I'll draft email subjects:
- "Your Starter Prompt Pack — 50 free credits inside" (A)
- "Starter prompts to get you building fast" (B)
- "Get 20 credits + tips to ship your first prompt" (C)
I'll post drafts by EOD.

Rebecca: Also need measurement plan: event names, success SQL, and QA checks. I'll own SQL and dashboard.

Lina: Awesome. Owners: Tom (copy), Omari (data + cohort tagging), Rebecca (measurement + dashboard), Eng (routing update). Can @eng-marketing pick this up? Target launch tomorrow 09:00 PT. :rocket:

Tom: Noted. I'll ping design for modal assets.

Omari: Will run pre-launch validation this afternoon, will post results here.

Rebecca: Added to the deck: /docs/launch/starter_templates/experiment-plan (link). Will run weekly check-ins.

Lina: Thanks everyone — sync at 3pm if we need final go. :thumbsup:
